raw:
@q query
  select ?m
  where match
    relation "mean"
    role subject "burn rate"
    role object ?m
    polarity affirmed
  end

@a1 assumed
  relation "refer to"
  role subject "runway"
  role object "the duration until cash runs out"
  polarity affirmed
  basis world

@a2 assumed
  relation "say"
  role subject "the CFO"
  role object "the user's organization has 14 months of runway"
  polarity affirmed
  basis implicature
